notes.title: Patch 1.065
notes.content:
Potentially the final update for now.

Adds a bunch new content, new islands, missions, and interactions. Added new ways for interactions to affect the player and lead to combat. Many bug fixes as well along with small QoL fixes. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update v1.06
notes.content:
I've been steadily updating HaD over time but haven't documented them here. There have been a huge number of bug fixes. Bugs related to Saving and Loading have been fixed, bugs halting missions progress have been completed, as well as a bug that can prevent the player from buy new weapons. Many, many more.

There was a UI makeover, ability to speed up the passing of time, and many other improvements, both in terms of gameplay and also visually. This is the most comprehensive update yet bringing it to a, hopefully, very stable point. If you have any issues, check out the discord linked on the Title Scene and let me know!
